description: This file implements an Android foreground service called ForegroundService, including an inner Controller activity class for starting and stopping the service via UI buttons. It demonstrates handling of foreground notifications, wake locks, and alarms for scheduling service start.

classes.name: ForegroundService
classes.description: A service that runs in the foreground, displaying a persistent notification. Contains logic to handle wake locks, notifications, and command actions for foreground and background operation.

classes.name: ForegroundService.Controller
classes.description: An inner Activity class providing UI buttons to start, stop, and schedule the ForegroundService with different configurations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the NotificationManager when service is created.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases resources and removes notification when service is destroyed.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles intents to start the service in foreground or background modes, manages wake locks, and schedules alarms.

methods.name: handleDestroy
methods.description: Clean-up method called during destruction to release WakeLocks and cancel callbacks.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.
